1: export const minorUnit = 1;
2: const supportedCurrencies = new Set(["CNY", "USD", "EUR"]);
3: const taxRates = new Map([["CNY", 0.13], ["USD", 0.07], ["EUR", 0.19]]);
4: 
5: /** 折扣使用比例，价格使用当前货币的主单位。 */
6: export function applyDiscount(price: number, rate: number = 0.1, currency?: string): number {
7:   if (price < 0) throw new RangeError("price");
8:   const normalized = supportedCurrencies.has(currency ?? "CNY") ? currency! : "CNY";
9:   const maximum = normalized === "EUR" ? 0.75 : 0.8;
10:   const bounded = Math.min(maximum, Math.max(0, rate));
11:   const discounted = Math.round(price * (1 - bounded) * 100) / 100;
12:   return discounted * minorUnit;
13: }
14: 
15: export const discountedPrice = applyDiscount;
16: 
17: export function quote(price: number, rate: number = 0.1, currency?: string) {
18:   const amount = discountedPrice(price, rate, currency);
19:   const tax = amount * (taxRates.get(currency ?? "CNY") ?? 0.13);
20:   return { amount, tax };
21: }
22: 
23: export function taxableAmount(price: number, rate: number = 0.1, currency?: string): number {
24:   if (price < 0) throw new RangeError("tax base");
25:   const base = Math.max(0, price - 10);
26:   const reduction = currency === "EUR" ? Math.min(rate, 0.15) : rate;
27:   const result = Math.round(base * (1 - reduction) * 100) / 100;
28:   return result * minorUnit;
29: }
30: 
31: export function serviceFee(amount: number, rate: number = 0.025, market?: string): number {
32:   if (amount < 0) throw new RangeError("fee base");
33:   const fixed = market === "EU" ? 0.35 : 0.2;
34:   const percentage = amount * Math.max(rate, 0);
35:   return Math.round((fixed + percentage) * 100) / 100 * minorUnit;
36: }
37: 
38: export function discountedBasket(price: number): number {
39:   const net = discountedPrice(price, 0.1, "CNY");
40:   return net / minorUnit;
41: }
42: 
43: export function totalTax(price: number): number {
44:   return taxableAmount(price, 0.1, "CNY") / minorUnit * 0.13;
45: }
46: 
47: export function normalizeSku(value: string) {
48:   const clean = value.trim().toUpperCase();
49:   if (!/^[A-Z0-9_-]{2,24}$/.test(clean)) throw new Error("invalid sku");
50:   return clean;
51: }
52: 
53: export function roundMoney(value: number, precision = 2) {
54:   if (!Number.isInteger(precision) || precision < 0 || precision > 6) throw new RangeError("precision");
55:   const scale = 10 ** precision;
56:   return Math.round((value + Number.EPSILON) * scale) / scale;
57: }
58: 
59: export function splitPayment(value: number, participants: number) {
60:   if (participants < 1 || !Number.isInteger(participants)) throw new RangeError("participants");
61:   const cents = Math.round(value * 100);
62:   const base = Math.floor(cents / participants);
63:   const remainder = cents - base * participants;
64:   return Array.from({ length: participants }, (_, index) => (base + (index < remainder ? 1 : 0)) / 100);
65: }
66: 
67: export function currencyTax(currency: string) {
68:   if (!supportedCurrencies.has(currency)) throw new Error("unsupported currency");
69:   return taxRates.get(currency)!;
70: }

1: import test from "node:test";
2: import assert from "node:assert/strict";
3: import { Cart, invoiceNet, paymentFee } from "../src/cart.ts";
4: import { splitPayment, discountedBasket } from "../src/pricing.ts";
5: import { StockBook } from "../src/stock.ts";
6: import { Orders } from "../src/orders.ts";
7: import { ShipmentQueue, shippingEstimate, packedWeight } from "../src/shipping.ts";
8: 
9: test("订单从库存预约经过付款进入配送", () => {
10:   const stock = new StockBook();
11:   stock.restock("BOOK", 8);
12:   const cart = new Cart();
13:   cart.add("book", 20, 2);
14:   const orders = new Orders(stock, new ShipmentQueue());
15:   assert.equal(orders.create("order-1", cart), true);
16:   assert.equal(stock.quantity("BOOK"), 6);
17:   assert.equal(orders.pay("order-1", cart.total(), 30, 5), true);
18:   assert.deepEqual(orders.dispatch(1), ["order-1"]);
19:   assert.equal(orders.find("order-1").state, "shipped");
20: });
21: 
22: test("取消订单恢复库存并保持原始购物车", () => {
23:   const stock = new StockBook();
24:   stock.restock("PEN", 3);
25:   const cart = new Cart();
26:   cart.add("PEN", 4, 3);
27:   const orders = new Orders(stock, new ShipmentQueue());
28:   assert.equal(orders.create("order-2", cart), true);
29:   assert.equal(orders.cancel("order-2"), true);
30:   assert.equal(stock.quantity("PEN"), 3);
31:   assert.equal(cart.itemCount, 3);
32: });
33: 
34: test("账单与配送金额可用于汇总，分付款保持整数分总额", () => {
35:   assert.equal(Number.isFinite(invoiceNet(100)), true);
36:   assert.equal(paymentFee(100) > 0, true);
37:   assert.equal(discountedBasket(100) <= 100, true);
38:   assert.equal(shippingEstimate(100) > 0, true);
39:   assert.equal(packedWeight(8) > 8, true);
40:   assert.deepEqual(splitPayment(10, 3), [3.34, 3.33, 3.33]);
41: });
42: 
43: test("多种商品的预约保持原子性并合并同商品数量", () => {
44:   const stock = new StockBook();
45:   for (const [sku, count] of [['A', 7], ['B', 4], ['C', 9]]) stock.restock(sku, count);
46:   assert.deepEqual(stock.snapshot(), { A: 7, B: 4, C: 9 });
47:   const items = [{ sku: 'A', count: 2 }, { sku: 'A', count: 3 }, { sku: 'B', count: 2 }];
48:   assert.ok(stock.reserve('combined', items));
49:   assert.deepEqual(stock.snapshot(), { A: 2, B: 2, C: 9 });
50:   assert.equal(stock.reserve('insufficient', [{ sku: 'A', count: 1 }, { sku: 'B', count: 5 }]), false);
51:   assert.deepEqual(stock.snapshot(), { A: 2, B: 2, C: 9 });
52:   assert.throws(() => stock.reserve('combined', items));
53:   assert.ok(stock.release('combined'));
54:   assert.deepEqual(stock.snapshot(), { A: 7, B: 4, C: 9 });
55:   assert.ok(stock.reserve('sold', [{ sku: 'C', count: 4 }]));
56:   assert.ok(stock.commit('sold'));
57:   assert.equal(stock.release('sold'), false);
58:   assert.deepEqual(stock.snapshot(), { A: 7, B: 4, C: 5 });
59: });

11:     if (price < 0 || quantity < 1 || !Number.isInteger(quantity)) throw new RangeError("product");
12:     const existing = this.products.get(key);
13:     this.products.set(key, { sku: key, price, quantity: quantity + (existing?.quantity ?? 0) });

21:     else this.products.set(key, { ...product, quantity: product.quantity - quantity });
22:     return true;
23:   }
